join_keys: Every row id is an existing ID from rules.json (sha256 71b4e4e67173cf7da6fbff8cd7dfbb36533250278565469b67bfd0b77468ad2a): 37 k_rules machine IDs, 66 proposed_b helper event IDs, 4 bookkeeping IDs, 5 administrative IDs. No ID is added, renamed or split.
language: schema-supplement.json row_language (expressions, effects, delta vectors, reads) and guards. Every value, row, cell, index and when string below is an Expr in that grammar, evaluated on the pre-image. Every select_when is such an Expr except on the nine .entry rows, which dispatch.select step 3 selects through dispatch.helperPlan (their select_when text names that rule). Reads whose loc is 'value row' or 'field slot' resolve through deref() or field(), whose bound is active(prog.constants) or active(prog.constantFields) for a Const ref and pre.active.data or pre.active.dataFields for a Data ref.

T-LEGACY.precedence_note: P1 cannot select a legacy row (its control is non-final); P3 does not apply (not helper-eligible); no legacy row has a positive DataNodes, DataFields, EnvironmentCells or HelperTasks delta, so P6 never fires; frame capacity is unreachable by admitRun R4
T-LEGACY.result_slot: a row whose select_when reads r consumes the staged result and ends with clearResult; every other legacy row requires pre.result absent
T-LEGACY.preserved: every register, table row and active length not written by the row's effects; in particular initialFuel, stackLimit, every arena, every logical allocation counter, helperWork, helperVisits, taskLive = 0 and helper absent
T-LEGACY.error_publication: a row that sets reg.control to Error(c) is followed by P1: Rejected(c) at cost 0, even at zero fuel

T-HELPER.eventKind: HelperEnter for .entry, HelperExit for .exit, HelperFail for .failure, HelperVisit otherwise
T-HELPER.base_deltas: [-1, 1, 1, helperVisits, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] unless the row lists its own
T-HELPER.cap_failure: for each kind in the row's cap_kinds_possible whose final delta is positive, in the fixed P6 order: Exhausted(kind), charged (P4 effects only); no write, no allocation-counter change, helperVisits unchanged; reg.helper, img.tasks, reg.taskLive and reg.result exactly as in the pre-image
T-HELPER.preserved: reg.control, reg.controlOrigin, reg.envRoot, reg.depth, img.frames, reg.stackLimit, reg.initialFuel, reg.referenceCursor, every arena row below its pre-image active length, and every register or helper field not written by the row
T-HELPER.erasure: an image with helper or result present erases to its legacy pre-state: drop reg.helper, reg.result, img.tasks and reg.taskLive; rows and value slots written during the interval are unreachable from legacy roots and ignored by decodeStep (rules.json:7323; interfaces.md:126)

T-ADMIN.note: Realized by genesis (Startup) or by precedence P1/P2 (Publish); not a step row and has no plan function (answers Muse F-05). Publish realizations emit a StepEvent; Startup realizations emit none.

T-DISABLED.scope: sherlock-helper-microstep/1 under grammarDomain DedicatedSorts only (answers Opus1 F6, Opus2 L-6)
T-DISABLED.meaning: No source-defined condition enables this event under DedicatedSorts; select never returns it. A core trace, witness or post-image presenting this RuleId is C-INV; the host reports HostViolation{DisabledRuleReached}. This disposition does not decide the GenericNominal schedule; an extension overlay may re-enable the ID with a complete row, fresh votes and fresh exact-fuel oracles.

T-EXTENSION.meaning: Enabled only by an extension feature (GenericNominal grammar, nested patterns or nested helper activation) that admission excludes under DedicatedSorts. A core trace presenting it is C-INV; the host reports HostViolation{ExtensionRuleReached}. The extension owner supplies a complete row in this format, with votes, before enabling it.
